format: html
execute:

---

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(CAISOPEA)
library(duckdb)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
tbl_pointer <- tbl(con, "read_parquet('/Users/sumanth/Desktop/BidCurves/CAISO_dam_big.parquet')")

dam_data <- tbl_pointer |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, SELFSCHEDMW) |>
  collect()

# Read as Arrow Tables so duckplyr can convert them without datetime type issues
outages  <- arrow::read_parquet(here("prior_trade_day_outages.parquet"), as_data_frame = FALSE)
id_attrs <- arrow::read_parquet(here("ID_attributes.parquet"), as_data_frame = FALSE) |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, max_mw)
```

## Run Matching

```{r}
#| label: run-matching
#| message: false

results <- get_curtailment_matches(
  dam_data          = dam_data,
  outages           = outages,
  id_attrs          = id_attrs,
  tolerance         = 0.05,
  pmax_tolerance    = 0.10,
  min_matches       = 2L,
  resolve_collisions = TRUE,
  top_n             = 5L,
  return_detail     = TRUE
)

cat("Final unique matches (collision-resolved): ", nrow(results$final_matches), "\n")
cat("Top-candidate rows (up to 5 per resource): ", nrow(results$top_candidates), "\n")
cat("Resources with candidates:                 ",
    n_distinct(results$top_candidates$`RESOURCE ID`), "\n")
```

## Final Matches

One row per named resource — best seq ID after collision resolution.

```{r}
#| label: final-matches

results$final_matches
```

## Top Candidates (up to 5 per resource)

Up to 5 candidate seq IDs per named resource, ranked by score with no collision
resolution applied. The same `RESOURCEBID_SEQ` may appear for multiple resources.

```{r}
#| label: top-candidates

results$top_candidates
```

## Confidence Distribution

```{r}
#| label: plot-confidence
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4

plot_data <- results$final_matches |>
  filter(is.finite(confidence), confidence < 1)

n_unambiguous <- sum(results$final_matches$confidence == 1)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = 1 / (1 - confidence))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.2, y = Inf,
           label = "ratio > 2  (confidence \u2265 0.5)",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, color = "firebrick", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0(n_unambiguous, " unambiguous matches\n(confidence = 1.0)"),
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, color = "grey40") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Raw Confidence Ratios (log scale)",
    subtitle = "Excludes unambiguous matches (confidence = 1.0)",
    x = "Raw Score Ratio (log scale)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Export

```{r}
#| label: export
#| message: false

dir.create(here("final_outputs"), showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  results$final_matches,
  here("final_outputs", "curtailment_matches_final.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  results$top_candidates,
  here("final_outputs", "curtailment_top_candidates.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  results$match_detail,
  here("final_outputs", "curtailment_match_detail.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Wrote final_outputs/curtailment_matches_final.csv    —", nrow(results$final_matches), "rows\n")
cat("Wrote final_outputs/curtailment_top_candidates.csv   —", nrow(results$top_candidates), "rows\n")
cat("Wrote final_outputs/curtailment_match_detail.csv     —", nrow(results$match_detail), "rows\n")
```
